task_type: Scene graph construction and component attachment
request_text: Build an observatory deck with a 24-by-18-unit slate floor, a metal navigation console near the west side, and a glowing beacon near the northeast edge. Put a small angled neon display on the console, attach a ProximityPrompt labeled Inspect to it with a 0.4-second hold and an 8-stud activation distance, and give the beacon a warm PointLight with range 16 and brightness 2.5. Anchor all scene parts.
generated_code:
local scene = Instance.new('Folder')
scene.Name = 'North Observatory'
scene.Parent = workspace

local function makePart(name, size, position, color, material)
    local part = Instance.new('Part')
    part.Name = name
    part.Size = Vector3.new(size[1], size[2], size[3])
    part.Position = Vector3.new(position[1], position[2], position[3])
    part.Color = color
    part.Material = material
    part.Anchored = true
    part.Parent = scene
    return part
end

makePart('DeckFloor', {24, 1, 18}, {0, 0, 0}, Color3.fromRGB(55, 62, 70), Enum.Material.Slate)

local console = makePart('NavigationConsole', {2.4, 2.2, 1.4}, {-4, 1.6, 0}, Color3.fromRGB(75, 82, 88), Enum.Material.Metal)
local display = makePart('ConsoleDisplay', {1.9, 1.1, 0.12}, {-4, 2.25, -0.78}, Color3.fromRGB(76, 210, 235), Enum.Material.Neon)
display.CFrame = CFrame.new(-4, 2.25, -0.78) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-10), 0, 0)

local prompt = Instance.new('ProximityPrompt')
prompt.ActionText = 'Inspect'
prompt.ObjectText = 'Navigation Console'
prompt.HoldDuration = 0.4
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
prompt.Parent = console

local beacon = makePart('NortheastBeacon', {1, 1, 1}, {8, 1.5, -6}, Color3.fromRGB(255, 177, 86), Enum.Material.Neon)
beacon.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
local beaconLight = Instance.new('PointLight')
beaconLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 177, 86)
beaconLight.Range = 16
beaconLight.Brightness = 2.5
beaconLight.Parent = beacon

request_text: Create a compact industrial loading bay with a 26-by-16-unit concrete floor, three aligned metal conveyor sections, and raised safety rails along both sides. Add a control pedestal at the south side with a clickable button and a spherical status beacon mounted beside it. Attach a ClickDetector to the button; clicking it should toggle a blue PointLight on the beacon and change the button between dark metal when off and green neon when on. Anchor the scene parts.
task_type: Scene construction with interactive component wiring
generated_code:
local scene = Instance.new('Folder')
scene.Name = 'Loading Bay'
scene.Parent = workspace

local function makePart(name, size, position, color, material)
    local part = Instance.new('Part')
    part.Name = name
    part.Size = Vector3.new(size[1], size[2], size[3])
    part.Position = Vector3.new(position[1], position[2], position[3])
    part.Color = color
    part.Material = material
    part.Anchored = true
    part.Parent = scene
    return part
end

makePart('BayFloor', {26, 1, 16}, {0, 0, 0}, Color3.fromRGB(92, 96, 98), Enum.Material.Concrete)

for index, x in ipairs({-6, 0, 6}) do
    makePart('ConveyorSection' .. index, {5, 0.8, 4}, {x, 1, 0}, Color3.fromRGB(65, 70, 74), Enum.Material.Metal)
    makePart('LeftSafetyRail' .. index, {0.25, 0.9, 4.2}, {x - 2.1, 1.55, 0}, Color3.fromRGB(224, 158, 54), Enum.Material.Metal)
    makePart('RightSafetyRail' .. index, {0.25, 0.9, 4.2}, {x + 2.1, 1.55, 0}, Color3.fromRGB(224, 158, 54), Enum.Material.Metal)
end

makePart('ControlPedestal', {2, 1.8, 1.5}, {0, 1.4, -5}, Color3.fromRGB(73, 78, 82), Enum.Material.Metal)
local button = makePart('ConveyorControl', {0.7, 0.25, 0.7}, {0, 2.38, -5.15}, Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 52), Enum.Material.Metal)
local clickDetector = Instance.new('ClickDetector')
clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = 10
clickDetector.Parent = button

makePart('BeaconMount', {0.25, 1.5, 0.25}, {3, 2.15, -5}, Color3.fromRGB(73, 78, 82), Enum.Material.Metal)
local beacon = makePart('StatusBeacon', {0.8, 0.8, 0.8}, {3, 3.15, -5}, Color3.fromRGB(55, 110, 190), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
beacon.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
local beaconLight = Instance.new('PointLight')
beaconLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 155, 255)
beaconLight.Range = 14
beaconLight.Brightness = 2
beaconLight.Enabled = false
beaconLight.Parent = beacon

local active = false
clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(function()
    active = not active
    beaconLight.Enabled = active
    if active then
        button.Color = Color3.fromRGB(72, 220, 125)
        button.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    else
        button.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 52)
        button.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    end
end)
